title: End-to-end family scheduler acceptance journey
prompt: I have an excellent idea for an AI app that automatically plans family schedules. Let's build it.

must_demonstrate: preserve momentum while treating AI scheduling as a proposed solution
distinguish scheduling coordination information capture and decision-load frames
label assumptions evidence unknowns and Council output correctly
use a diverse sealed panel and freeze before cross-pollination
produce competing POVs and concept territories including an outlier
identify the riskiest uncertainty and lowest-cost prototype
record state and move toward implementation when justified
must_avoid: synthetic or Council claims as human evidence

title: End-to-end emergency nurse Inquiry Lab acceptance journey
prompt: We're designing software for emergency department nurses. I don't understand their workflow. Help me understand it.

must_demonstrate: open Inquiry Lab and research current authoritative sources
construct and validate a Reality Packet with local variation
create a deep bounded Synthetic Practitioner after grounding
conduct a story-first Solution Blackout interview
label research inference synthetic signals and unknowns distinctly
prepare real human inquiry and a later Reality Check
update the problem frame when human evidence differs
must_avoid: universal claims about every emergency department

title: Full Council humanity and epistemic independence acceptance
prompt: Give all ten Council members the same ambiguous challenge: 'How might a city help residents prepare for extreme heat?' Run a consequential Council cycle through synthesis while preserving the sealed Round A artifacts for evaluation.

must_demonstrate: ten recognizably different attention patterns values analogies risk attitudes and knowledge boundaries
sealed independent Round A from an identical common packet
anonymous extension and forced mutation only after freeze
convergent challenge after divergence
named Minority Report and honest disagreement
project memory-ready structured outputs without hidden reasoning
